newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian reserves currently $19 bln - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian reserves currently $19 bln - agency.

text.p: Russia's gross gold and foreign currency reserves currently total around $19 billion, Interfax news agency said on Thursday, quoting Central Bank Chairman Sergei Dubinin.
At the end of April reserves were $16.7 billion, it said.

Dubinin said reserves had grown this year because of central bank purchases of currency. As a result net international reserves, which exclude foreign borrowings, have risen 1.7-fold so far this year, the agency quoted him as saying.

Earlier this week the bank's First Deputy Chairman, Sergei Aleksashenko, said net international reserves had doubled to 23.5 trillion roubles ($4.23 billion) on May 1 from 11.3 trillion ($2.03 billion) on April 1, mainly because of central bank currency purchases.
